calibration: Fixed-category Jeffreys mean (successes+0.5)/(n+1); logically inconsistent caption has probability0; no threshold retuning on calibration
declared_ood: Both public image halves absent, mask entirely zero, both text class hints unknown; this is a declared missing-input distribution only
ece: Same ten confidence-ppm bins as legacy native qualification, calculated over full cohort and ID cohort separately
outcome: Actual candidate caption valid and text facts/relation/image facts/crossmodal agreement all correct under the same frozen audit observer
outcome_time: Private candidate grade is unavailable to prediction and final commitment
owner_role_in_calibration: Six actual native state paths certify the frozen readout table; offline calibration candidates use that table, not a claimed per-case native execution
public_inputs: Actual initial caption, arrived preference scalar, actual candidate PNG/UTF8, public input mask, frozen reward CNN features
score_event: Candidate correctness, including every rejected candidate; not correctness conditional on acceptance
selective_rule: The fixed public head's selected category and positive final entropic value relative to abstention
source_exclusions: All outcome-head fit/validation source identities; all new qualification sources
uncertainty: Exact zero-count one-sided95% OOD upper=1-.05**(1/n_ood); nonzero OOD accepts fail the unchanged design
